verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents that each agent has persistent memory that the user can edit, which covers part of the inspect/edit requirement. The privacy page says chat data is stored client-side by default, and the product can be self-hosted, but nothing confirms that the memory store itself lives on the user's machine. Missing for 10: explicit memory deletion controls, evidence that the memory store sits locally on the user's machine, an open/inspectable storage format for memory (the Markdown source mode covers agent profiles, not memory), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
